name: travelclaw
description: Self-hosted travel desk gateway. One process for sessions, tools, and memory.

scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @travelclaw/shared build && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/api dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @travelclaw/shared build && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/agent-core build && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/api build && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @travelclaw/shared test && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/agent-core test && pnpm --filter @travelclaw/api test
